chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hanan ibn Sudeyr, from his father, who said:
Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) loved to see a man who was fond of dates, due to the love of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) for dates.

key_terms.تَمْرِيّاً: A person who loves or is fond of dates

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Ali (AS) love to see people who liked dates?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin) demonstrates the Shia emphasis on *ittiba'* (following the Prophet) by valuing the consumption of dates as a tangible manifestation of love for the Messenger. This practice is not merely dietary but serves as a spiritual link to the Sunnah, reinforcing the Prophet's preference for this blessed fruit which is frequently mentioned in Islamic tradition as a staple of the Prophets. The hadith underscores how daily habits, when aligned with the Prophet's inclinations, become acts of devotion and remembrance.
